items.label: Sturdy & Weather-Resistant Construction
items.value: Crafted with premium hand-woven rattan and a rust-proof powder-coated steel frame, this outdoor sectional set withstands harsh weather, UV rays, and moisture. The tempered glass coffee table resists scratches and impacts, ensuring long-lasting durability for patios, poolsides, or gardens.

items.label: Ultra-Comfortable & Easy-Clean Cushions
items.value: Relax on thick high-density foam cushions wrapped in 100% polyester covers for superior support. Removable, machine-washable covers feature waterproof and UV-resistant fabric, making maintenance effortless while keeping comfort intact.

items.label: Modular & Versatile Design
items.value: The 7-piece set (2 corner chairs, 4 armless chairs, 1 coffee table) adapts to any space—configure into L-shaped, U-shaped, or linear layouts. Secure connecting clips and anti-slip strips keep sections stable, perfect for balconies, porches, or open decks.

items.label: Premium Handwoven Aesthetic
items.value: Artisan-woven wicker strands offer a luxurious texture and fade-resistant finish, blending elegance with outdoor resilience. Designed to endure sun, rain, and humidity without compromising style.

items.label: Hassle-Free Assembly & Support
items.value: Includes pre-packaged hardware, tools, and clear instructions for quick setup (electric screwdriver recommended). Ships in two boxes. Backed by reliable after-sales service for peace of mind.
